_meta.description: Tier 3 — Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR, BEPS Action 13 / Wet Vpb art. 29b-29h) and OESO Pillar Two / GloBE (Wet minimumbelasting 2024). Eight new schemas (GroupEntityRegistry, CbcrJurisdictionSummary, Pillar2JurisdictionComputation, Pillar2SafeHarbour, QdmttReturn, GlobeInformationReturn, CbcrReturn, TaxTreatyOverview). All quantitative logic is declarative (x-openregister-calculations for ETR/SBIE/top-up tax, x-openregister-aggregations for the 7-field CbCR roll-up) per ADR-031 — no GlobeIncomeCalculator.php / QdmttService.php. Lifecycle automation per x-openregister-lifecycle; cross-schema preconditions (QDMTT-priority gate, reconciliation sign-off) delegated to OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\CbcrPillar2Guard (ADR-031 exception path). Seed data pre-loads a worked NL/DE FY2026 example group. EUR 750M threshold detection, GloBE 35-item correction audit trail, safe-harbour transitional tests (2024-2026), and OESO CbC/GIR XML export are declared as schema metadata; live XML rendering + SBR/Digipoort submission are openconnector-owned (T4) and DEFERRED — see tasks.md.

GroupEntityRegistry.title: Group Entity Registry
GroupEntityRegistry.description: Constituent entity of a multinational group within the consolidation perimeter (REQ-CBC-002). Holds incorporation + tax-residency jurisdiction, consolidation method/percentage, CbCR/Pillar 2 scope flags, and identification (LEI, VAT). The per-jurisdiction CbCR summary is the sum of all in-scope entities sharing a jurisdiction. A person/owner is a Nextcloud entity (responsibleOwner FK to the NC user directory) — never an invented contact schema.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: GroupEntityRegistry changes (jurisdiction, taxResidency, consolidationMethod/Percentage, cbcrIncluded / pillar2Included flags, excludedEntityType, UPE thresholdCrossed flips, lifecycle transitions) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — every change reshapes the per-jurisdiction CbCR/Pillar 2 perimeter and is subject to operator + Belastingdienst auditor review.

x-openregister-threshold-watcher.description: EUR 750M prior-year consolidated-revenue threshold watcher for CbCR / Pillar 2 scope (REQ-CBC-001 / BEPS Action 13 / Wet Vpb art. 29b / Wet minimumbelasting 2024). Declarative contract for the openconnector-owned BackgroundJob that runs nightly on a live instance — when the prior-year consolidated revenue (sum of CbcrJurisdictionSummary.totalRevenue across all jurisdictions for the prior period) crosses thresholdEur, the watcher sets UPE.thresholdCrossed=true + UPE.thresholdCrossedAt=now() + UPE.cbcrIncluded=true + UPE.pillar2Included=true on the UltimateParentEntity record, and emits the first-CbCR (12 months after FYE) and first-GIR (18 months) deadline warnings as system notifications.

firstCbcrDeadline.description: Emit first-CbCR filing warning 12 months after the FYE following the threshold-crossing year.

firstGirDeadline.description: Emit first-GIR (GloBE Information Return) filing warning 18 months after the FYE following the threshold-crossing year.

x-openregister-threshold-watcher.status: DEFERRED — declarative contract only; live BackgroundJob ships with the openconnector cron-watcher apply cycle on a live instance.

CbcrJurisdictionSummary.title: CbCR Jurisdiction Summary
CbcrJurisdictionSummary.description: Per-jurisdiction aggregation of the seven mandatory CbCR fields for a fiscal year (REQ-CBC-002). totalRevenue is derived declaratively from unrelated + related party revenue (ADR-031). One summary per jurisdiction per period; the sum of all in-scope GroupEntityRegistry records sharing a jurisdiction. Intra-jurisdiction transactions eliminate; cross-jurisdiction intra-group revenue survives as relatedPartyRevenue.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: CbcrJurisdictionSummary changes (the 7 CbCR fields, mainBusinessActivities, employeeMethodologyNote, lifecycle transitions to reconciled / locked) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — the summary feeds the CbCR XML submission directly and must reproduce on demand for Belastingdienst MCAA partner-jurisdiction exchange (REQ-CBC-002 / REQ-CBC-008 / REQ-CBC-010).

mainBusinessActivities.title: Main Business Activities

employeeMethodologyNote.title: Employee Methodology Note

totalRevenue.description: totalRevenue = unrelatedPartyRevenue + relatedPartyRevenue (REQ-CBC-002 / design D3). Declarative per ADR-031 — no aggregation service.

entityRollup.description: CbCR 7-field roll-up: sum the in-scope GroupEntityRegistry records sharing this jurisdiction into the summary (REQ-CBC-002 / design D3). Intra-jurisdiction transactions eliminate; cross-jurisdiction related-party revenue survives.

x-openregister-consolidation-source.description: Declarative consolidation feed for the 7 mandatory CbCR fields (REQ-CBC-002). Per-entity consolidation data is sourced from the bookkeeping-consolidation-commercial app: revenue, profit before tax, income tax, capital, and accumulated earnings are summed per (period, jurisdiction) tuple, with elimination logic that drops intra-jurisdictie transactions while preserving cross-jurisdictie related-party revenue (split into related vs unrelated). The runtime consumer ships with the bookkeeping-consolidation-commercial integration apply cycle on a live instance.

fieldMap.relatedPartyRevenue: EntityConsolidationLine.revenueRelated (sum, post-elimination; intra-jurisdictie eliminated, cross-jurisdictie preserved)

x-openregister-consolidation-source.eliminationRule: intra-jurisdictie group transactions eliminate; cross-jurisdictie intra-group revenue survives as relatedPartyRevenue (OESO CbC technical guidance).
x-openregister-consolidation-source.status: DEFERRED — declarative contract only; live integration ships with the not-yet-merged bookkeeping-consolidation-commercial apply cycle on a live instance.

Pillar2JurisdictionComputation.title: Pillar 2 Jurisdiction Computation
Pillar2JurisdictionComputation.description: Per-jurisdiction GloBE / Pillar 2 computation for a period (REQ-CBC-003..006). GloBE income carries the audit trail of the ~35 OESO corrections in globeIncomeAdjustments; ETR, top-up tax rate, SBIE carve-out, excess profit and top-up tax amount are all derived declaratively (x-openregister-calculations, ADR-031) — no GlobeIncomeCalculator.php. QDMTT/IIR/UTPR allocation captured for the GIR. QDMTT priority over IIR is enforced by the lifecycle guard.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Pillar2JurisdictionComputation changes (commercialProfitBeforeTax, globeIncomeAdjustments[], coveredTaxAdjustments[], adjustedCoveredTaxes, payroll, tangibleAssetsNbv, qdmttAmount / iirAmount / utprAmount allocation, safeHarbourApplied flip, lifecycle transitions computed / approved / locked) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — the computation drives the GIR submission and the per-entity top-up tax allocation, and the OESO Model Rules require a full audit trail of each correction (REQ-CBC-003 / REQ-CBC-004 / REQ-CBC-006).

commercialProfitBeforeTax.description: Commercial (accounting) profit before tax — the starting point for GloBE income (REQ-CBC-003).
commercialProfitBeforeTax.title: Commercial Profit Before Tax

globeIncomeAdjustments.description: Audit trail of the OESO-prescribed GloBE income corrections (REQ-CBC-003). Each line is signed: a negative amount excludes income, a positive amount adds it back.

type.description: GloBE correction category per OESO Model Rules Art. 3.2-3.5.
type.title: Type

globeIncomeAdjustments.title: Globe Income Adjustments

coveredTaxAdjustments.title: Covered Tax Adjustments

adjustedCoveredTaxes.title: Adjusted Covered Taxes

payroll.title: Payroll

tangibleAssetsNbv.title: Tangible Assets Nbv

carveOutRatePayroll.title: Carve Out Rate Payroll

carveOutRateTangible.title: Carve Out Rate Tangible

qdmttApplicable.title: Qdmtt Applicable

qdmttAmount.title: Qdmtt Amount

iirAmount.title: Iir Amount

utprAmount.description: Top-up tax allocated via the Undertaxed Profits Rule (from FY2024).
utprAmount.title: Utpr Amount

safeHarbourApplied.description: Whether a transitional safe harbour replaced the full computation (REQ-CBC-007).
safeHarbourApplied.title: Safe Harbour Applied

safeHarbourTest.description: Which safe harbour applied and the supporting rationale (REQ-CBC-007).
safeHarbourTest.title: Safe Harbour Test

globeIncomeAdjustmentTotal.description: Sum of all GloBE income corrections (REQ-CBC-003).

globeIncome.description: GloBE income = commercial PBT + sum of corrections (REQ-CBC-003).

etrJurisdiction.description: ETR = adjustedCoveredTaxes / globeIncome, floored at 0 and capped at 1 (REQ-CBC-004).

excessProfit.description: Excess profit = max(0, GloBE income - SBIE) (REQ-CBC-005).

topUpTaxAmount.description: Top-up tax = top-up rate * excess profit (REQ-CBC-004/005).

x-openregister-hrmq-payroll-source.description: Declarative HRMQ payroll feed for the SBIE payroll carve-out base (REQ-CBC-005). Eligible payroll costs per jurisdiction (wages, salaries, payroll taxes, employer pension contributions; bonus, severance, equity comp per OESO Model Rules Art. 5.3.3 with stock-based compensation kept aligned with the GloBE income adjustment) sourced from the hrmq app: each PayrollLine record carries an employeeJurisdiction field; the feed sums eligible payroll across all PayrollLine records per (period, jurisdiction). Intercompany seconded staff use the operating-jurisdiction (not legal-employer-jurisdiction) per Art. 5.3.3.4. Optional feed — when hrmq is not provisioned, the carve-out base remains 0 and the carve-out collapses to the tangible-assets component only.
x-openregister-hrmq-payroll-source.secondmentRule: Seconded staff are attributed to the operating-jurisdiction (where the activity is performed), not the legal-employer-jurisdiction (OESO Model Rules Art. 5.3.3.4).

payrollMap.amountExpr: SUM(PayrollLine.eligibleCompensation WHERE employeeJurisdiction = @self.jurisdiction AND sbieEligible = true AND period = @self.period)

numberOfEmployeesFeed.description: Concurrent feed of FTE per jurisdiction into the CbCR 7-field roll-up (REQ-CBC-002).

annualRosterValidation.description: Annual deelnemersbestand validation of the employee roster before the actuarial valuation lock (parity with REQ-PEN-010 / pension-ias19 HRMQ roster source). Validation passes when SUM(Employee.fte) matches the prior-year roster within ±5% per jurisdiction.

x-openregister-hrmq-payroll-source.status: DEFERRED — optional declarative contract only; live integration ships with the not-yet-merged hrmq apply cycle on a live instance.

x-openregister-tangible-assets-source.description: Declarative tangible-assets-NBV feed for the SBIE carve-out base (REQ-CBC-005). Per-jurisdiction net book value of eligible tangible assets (excluding cash, cash equivalents, intangibles, and held-for-sale assets per OESO Model Rules Art. 5.3) sourced from the bookkeeping-fixed-assets-depreciation app: each FixedAsset record carries a jurisdictionOfUse field; the feed sums NBV across all in-scope assets per (period, jurisdiction). Inventory, financial assets, and IFRS 16 right-of-use lease assets are EXCLUDED from the OESO definition unless held in long-term operating use — the feed honours the OESO carve-out scoping flag on FixedAsset.sbieEligible.
exclusions: IFRS 16 RoU lease assets NOT in long-term operating use (Art. 5.3.4)

tangibleAssetsNbvMap.amountExpr: SUM(FixedAsset.netBookValueAtPeriodEnd WHERE jurisdictionOfUse = @self.jurisdiction AND sbieEligible = true AND period = @self.period)

x-openregister-tangible-assets-source.status: DEFERRED — declarative contract only; live integration ships with the not-yet-merged bookkeeping-fixed-assets-depreciation apply cycle on a live instance.

x-openregister-vpb-current-source.description: Declarative NL Vpb (vennootschapsbelasting) current-tax feed for the adjustedCoveredTaxes input on NL-resident jurisdiction computations (REQ-CBC-004). Per-entity Vpb current-year + prior-year amounts sourced from the bookkeeping-vpb-mkb app; the NL fiscal-unity consolidation collapses fiscale-eenheid members into a single entity-level current-tax line before the per-jurisdiction sum, so intra-fiscale-eenheid Vpb double-counting cannot occur. Only the NL jurisdiction record is fed; non-NL jurisdiction computations continue to source their covered tax from local-jurisdiction tax provisions.
x-openregister-vpb-current-source.fiscalUnityRule: Fiscale eenheid members are collapsed into a single moederentiteit current-tax line before the per-jurisdiction sum (Vpb art. 15); intra-fiscale-eenheid transactions are already eliminated upstream in bookkeeping-vpb-mkb.
x-openregister-vpb-current-source.status: DEFERRED — declarative contract only; live integration ships with the not-yet-merged bookkeeping-vpb-mkb apply cycle on a live instance.

x-openregister-deferred-tax-source.description: Declarative deferred-tax feed for the adjusted covered taxes (REQ-CBC-004) and the GloBE income corrections (REQ-CBC-003). Per-jurisdiction DTA timing differences sourced from the bookkeeping-deferred-tax app: commercial-fiscaal divergence (IFRS valuation vs Vpb box 1 valuation) is recast on the GloBE basis per OESO Model Rules Art. 4.4 (covered-tax effect) + Art. 3.2.7 (DTA effect on GloBE income). The DTA effect is appended to globeIncomeAdjustments as type=deferred-tax-effect; the covered-tax effect is appended to coveredTaxAdjustments and folded into adjustedCoveredTaxes.
x-openregister-deferred-tax-source.status: DEFERRED — declarative contract only; live integration ships with the not-yet-merged bookkeeping-deferred-tax apply cycle on a live instance.

Pillar2SafeHarbour.title: Pillar 2 Safe Harbour
Pillar2SafeHarbour.description: Transitional CbCR safe harbour test result per jurisdiction per period (REQ-CBC-007). A pass on any of the three tests (de-minimis, simplified-ETR, routine-profits) replaces the full Pillar 2 computation with a simplified return for the period (FY2024-2026 transition window).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Pillar2SafeHarbour changes (testApplied, testResult, dataSource, supportingCalculations) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — a safe-harbour pass replaces the full Pillar 2 computation for the jurisdiction and is the substantiation of choice in any Belastingdienst follow-up audit (REQ-CBC-007).

supportingCalculations.title: Supporting Calculations

QdmttReturn.title: QDMTT Return
QdmttReturn.description: Dutch Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax return for an NL-resident entity (REQ-CBC-006, Wet minimumbelasting 2024). QDMTT is levied in NL before any foreign IIR claim. XML/XBRL submission to the Belastingdienst via SBR/Digipoort is openconnector-owned (T4) and DEFERRED; this schema captures the filing record + status.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: QdmttReturn changes (taxableGlobeIncome, qualifyingDomesticEtr, qdmttPayable, paymentDueDate, filingDueDate, belastingdienstReference, xbrlSubmission file slot, lifecycle transitions submit / accept / reject) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — Wet minimumbelasting 2024 requires the Belastingdienst to be able to reconstruct the basis of the QDMTT charge for any open assessment year (REQ-CBC-006).

x-openregister-export-target.description: NL QDMTT-aangifte XML export contract (REQ-CBC-006). Declarative contract for the openconnector-owned XML renderer that generates the Dutch Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax filing on lifecycle transition `submit` (draft → submitted). Format follows the Belastingdienst Wet minimumbelasting 2024 filing spec; data is merged from this `qdmtt-return` record + the linked NL-resident `group-entity-registry` record + the per-jurisdiction `pillar2-jurisdiction-computation` for jurisdiction=NL. The rendered XML is stored to `xbrlSubmission` (FileService FK); the Belastingdienst SBR/Digipoort token is stored to `belastingdienstReference`.

x-openregister-export-target.status: DEFERRED — declarative contract only; live NL-QDMTT-XML renderer + Belastingdienst Digipoort submission adapter ship with the openconnector qdmtt-xml apply cycle on a live instance.

x-openregister-export-target.description: OESO CbCR XML v2.0 export contract (REQ-CBC-008). Declarative contract for the openconnector-owned XML renderer that generates the OESO Country-by-Country Report XML on lifecycle transition `submit` (reconciled → submitted). Data is merged from `cbcr-return` + `cbcr-jurisdiction-summary` + `group-entity-registry` records; the rendered XML is stored to `cbcrXmlSubmission` (FileService FK); the SBR/Digipoort submission token returned by the Belastingdienst is stored to `belastingdienstReference`.

renderSections.messageSpec: Group identification, sender, reporting period, message type code (CBC401 new, CBC402 correction).
renderSections.docSpec: Document reference id, document type indicator (OECD1 new, OECD2 correction, OECD3 deletion).
renderSections.cbcReports: Per-jurisdiction Summary block (7 CbCR fields) + ConstEntities block (one per GroupEntityRegistry record in scope).

x-openregister-export-target.status: DEFERRED — declarative contract only; live OESO-CBC-XML renderer + Digipoort submission adapter ship with the openconnector cbcr-xml apply cycle on a live instance.

TaxTreatyOverview.title: Tax Treaty Overview
TaxTreatyOverview.description: Reference register of double-taxation agreements (DTAs) used when allocating withholding taxes to jurisdictions within adjusted covered taxes (REQ-CBC-004). Reference data only; no lifecycle.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: TaxTreatyOverview changes (treatyName, treatyDate, withholdingRates, mliApplicability flip) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per REQ-AT-001 / ADR-022 — the treaty references drive withholding allocation in adjusted covered taxes (REQ-CBC-004); a stale rate would silently misstate the per-jurisdiction ETR. Reference data, but each amendment must reproduce on demand for auditor review.
